口径：: 自动隐藏未连接的对称部件

Caliber:: Highlights selected parts in the designer.
口径：: 在设计器中高亮选中的部件。

Caliber:: Toggles ambient smoke and fire effects placed in the world.
口径：: 开关世界中放置的环境烟雾与火焰特效。

Caliber:: Automatically hides symmetric parts while they are disconnected and after they are placed without a connection.
口径：: 当对称部件未连接时自动隐藏，无连接放置之后也会隐藏。

Caliber:: Disables the display of custom profile pictures in multiplayer. This will prevent you from seeing other players' custom profile pictures.
口径：: 在多人模式中禁用自定义头像显示，这样你就看不到其他玩家的自定义头像。

Caliber:: Adjusts the amount of weather particles. More particles mean reduced GPU performance.At High, an additional occlusion map gets rendered, which is CPU heavy.
口径：: 调整天气粒子的数量。粒子越多，GPU 性能越低。设为“高”时会额外渲染一张遮蔽贴图，CPU 开销较大。
